Download state data from the EIA API

Source: R/fetch_eia.R
fetch_eia.Rd

Queries version 2 of the US Energy Information Administration API and returns tidy long data. Results are cached (see rps_cache_dir()); the API key is never written to the cache.

Usage

fetch_eia(
  dataset = c("seds", "co2", "generation", "retail_sales"),
  series,
  states = NULL,
  years = NULL,
  api_key = NULL,
  cache = TRUE,
  refresh = FALSE
)

Arguments

dataset

One of "seds", "co2", "generation", "retail_sales".

series

Character vector of series identifiers (see Details).

states

States to download; any form accepted by harmonise_states(). NULL means all 50 states and DC.

years

Integer vector of years. NULL downloads all available years.

api_key

EIA API key. Defaults to the EIA_API_KEY environment variable.

cache

Use the local download cache.

refresh

Ignore any cached copy and download again.

Value

A data frame with columns state, year, series, value and unit, with attributes rps_source and rps_retrieved (download time, UTC).

Details

Supported datasets:

  • "seds": State Energy Data System. series are SEDS MSN codes, for example "TETCB" (total energy consumption, billion Btu).

  • "co2": energy-related CO2 emissions aggregates for all fuels. series are EIA sector ids: "TT" (total), "EC" (electric power), "IC" (industrial), "TC" (transportation), "RC" (residential), "CC" (commercial).

  • "generation": net generation, all sectors (forms EIA-923/906/920). series are fuel type ids such as "ALL", "COW", "NG", "NUC", "HYC", "WND", "SUN", "GEO", "WWW", "WAS".

  • "retail_sales": electricity retail sales and average price, all sectors. series are "sales" and/or "price".

Examples

if (FALSE) { # nzchar(Sys.getenv("EIA_API_KEY"))
fetch_eia("seds", "TETCB", states = c("CA", "TX"), years = 2015:2020)
}
